# muumuu_nameservers (Resource)

Manages the nameserver settings of a domain.

The settings always exist for a domain, so destroying this resource only removes it from the Terraform state and leaves the nameservers unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "muumuu_domain" "example" {
  fqdn = "example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

# Route 53 にネームサーバーを委譲する
resource "muumuu_nameservers" "example" {
  domain_id   = data.muumuu_domain.example.id
  setup_type  = "custom"
  nameservers = aws_route53_zone.example.name_servers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain (e.g. `MU00000001`).
- `setup_type` (String) How the nameservers are set up. One of `lolipop`, `custom`, `acquired_domain`, `muumuu_dns`, `parking`, `other`.

### Optional

- `confirm_existing_records` (Boolean) Confirms that existing DNS records may be affected by the change. Only sent to the API; not read back.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The nameservers. Required when `setup_type` is `custom`; otherwise set by Muumuu Domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import muumuu_nameservers.example <domain_id>
```
